disposition_reason: Original AAS measurements of arsenic, cadmium, chromium, lead, nickel and manganese in 21 commercial fruit juices from four brands on the Portuguese market, one value per juice in Table 3.
disposition_locator: Table 3, p. 436 (table is an image; read from rendered page)

study.design: Market survey of commercial fruit juices selected and collected by the national food safety authority
study.market: Portuguese market; samples selected and collected by ASAE (Portuguese Food and Economic Safety Authority)
study.method: Microwave digestion (HNO3/H2O2) of 3 mL juice; arsenic by hydride generation AAS, Cd, Cr, Pb, Mn and Ni by graphite furnace AAS (PerkinElmer AAnalyst 700)
lod: Quantification limits (10 S/N): Pb 0.31, Cd 0.69, Cr 1.25, As 1.87, Ni 2.14, Mn 3.65 µg/L
study.qa: Method validation: repeatability RSD < 7%, intermediate precision RSD < 7.5%, accuracy 84-111%; no certified reference material reported
